identity.name: Senator Excellence
identity.one_liner: The 40mm Senator Excellence with the in-house Calibre 36 — the German manufacture dress watch with a 100-hour reserve and a Glashütte three-quarter plate.

narrative.story: Glashütte Original is the other major manufacture in Glashütte, Saxony (the first being A. Lange & Söhne), and the Senator Excellence is its flagship three-hand dress watch. The Calibre 36 (2016) is a fully in-house automatic with a 100-hour reserve, a silicon balance spring, and the Glashütte three-quarter plate — the architectural signature of Saxon watchmaking. The Senator Excellence is the most-cited GO dress watch and the reference a collector cites when they want German manufacture quality at a price point below Lange.
narrative.collector_notes: The Calibre 36 replaced the older Calibre 39. The three-quarter plate is a Glashütte signature that differs from the Swiss full-bridge or cock architecture.
